label: The trigger index deduplicates by construction: lookup() accumulates postings into a byPath Map keyed by document path, so one document yields at most one row and span-dedupe.js has no (file,start,end) key to group on.

A strict final-k cut already exists in the trigger index: DEFAULT_LIMIT 20, slice after sort, and --limit 0 as the escape. The only missing half is observability, because truncated is a boolean while ordered.length is computed on the same line.

Runtime mirrors cannot duplicate a documented result set: recipes search specs and .skilled as positional roots, and ripgrep does not follow the .claude/skills symlink (measured 0 files). .claude/agents is a real directory holding 12 files against 11 with 0 byte-identical, so those are near-duplicates that exact-span dedup would not collapse either.
z_archive is excluded in both lanes and 0 of 17,653 indexed paths contain z_archive, so no duplicate can arrive from an archive.

The duplication that is real is fan-out scaffolding. Recipe 2.2 on 'trigger_phrases' returned 24,986 files of which 3,346 are lineages (13.4%) and 1,213 prompts (4.9%); on the Gate-1-shaped phrase 'zero-hit fallback' it returned 7 files of which 5 are research/prompts/iteration-{1..5}.md (71.4%). Those five are not byte-identical (five distinct md5s), so exact-text dedup would not remove them.

The trigger index already prunes all research scaffolding via corpus.mjs exclusions ('**/research/lineages/**', 'specs/**/research/** except **/research/research.md', 'specs/**/lineages/**'), measured as 0 of 17,653 indexed paths under prompts/ or lineages/. Section 9's exclusion table names only lineages, so the doc cannot predict the broader rule; the parity test does cover the behaviour.

Verdict ADAPT: drop span-dedupe (no span unit, no mirror or archive duplicates) and drop final-k as a mechanism (already at 20). Keep only its observability half, adding ordered.length beside truncated in lookup-trigger-index.mjs (3-5 lines), plus one section 9 exclusion row for specs/**/research/** (2-4 lines). A prompts/ exclusion glob would be a new coverage decision, not a dedup pass, because lineages exclusion is a frozen documented divergence.
The trigger index's result unit is a document path; any dedup technique keyed on line or span ranges cannot apply to it without first changing the result unit.

Both lanes exclude runtime mirrors and z_archive; duplicate text can only reach a result set through corpora one lane deliberately keeps (ripgrep keeps lineages, and neither lane documents research/prompts).
